textos.As críticas deste grupo descrevem a expe: Reviews in this group describe watching the film as drawn out and boring, with scenes that stretch on with no clear purpose, leading some to speed up playback or even give up midway. The repetition of everyday actions without significant variation is pointed to as a factor that makes the work hard to endure.
textos.Falta de enredo e desenvolvimento de per: Lack of plot and character development
textos.Muitas reviews afirmam que o filme carec: Many reviews state that the film lacks an engaging story, with characters who have no depth or motivations that spark interest. The absence of dialogue and of clear narrative arcs makes the experience feel empty and monotonous, with nothing to hold on to emotionally.
textos.Este grupo critica o que considera uma p: This group criticizes what it considers a pretentious stance by the director and his admirers, suggesting that the work values difficulty and boredom as if they were artistic virtues. Some express frustration with the idea that only a specific, supposedly more cultured audience could appreciate the film, treating incomprehension as the viewer's failing.
textos.Uso repetitivo da trilha sonora e som: Repetitive use of score and sound
textos.A trilha sonora, caracterizada por um re: The score, characterized by a string refrain that repeats incessantly, is mentioned as an element that heightens the sense of monotony and wear. The ever-present sound of the wind is also cited as contributing to the oppressive atmosphere, but becomes tiring over time.
textos.Fotografia bela mas insuficiente para su: Beautiful cinematography that is not enough to carry the film
textos.Várias reviews reconhecem a qualidade da: Several reviews acknowledge the quality of the black-and-white cinematography and the careful visual composition, but argue that these aspects do not make up for the lack of narrative or emotional engagement. The beauty of the images is seen as an isolated attraction that does not justify the long running time and the drawn-out pace.
textos.Comparações desfavoráveis com outras obr: Unfavorable comparisons with other works or directors
textos.Algumas críticas comparam o filme a trab: Some reviews compare the film with the director's own earlier work or with filmmakers such as Tarkovsky, Fellini and Bergman, considering it inferior in narrative and depth. The work is sometimes described as a less effective version of other productions that also explore the everyday or pessimism, but manage to hold interest.
textos.Muitas reviews medianas apontam que o ri: Many middling reviews point out that the pace is excessively slow and that the repetition of everyday actions makes the experience drawn out and tiring, although they acknowledge the intention behind that choice.
textos.A fotografia em preto e branco e os plan: The black-and-white cinematography and the long takes are often praised as visually impressive, with framing that resembles paintings, even when the film is considered boring.
textos.As reviews medianas destacam que o filme: Middling reviews highlight that the film deals with themes such as nihilism, existential despair and the human struggle, but some consider the message obvious or excessively dense.
textos.A música e o som do vento são mencionado: The music and the sound of the wind are mentioned as elements that heighten the oppressive atmosphere, although the repetition of the score may bother some viewers.
textos.Várias reviews medianas relatam que, ape: Several middling reviews report that, despite admiring the approach, they could not engage emotionally or feel a connection with the characters, resulting in an experience that is more intellectual than sensory.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas consideram que: Some middling reviews consider that the film runs longer than necessary, with scenes that could be shortened without harm to the work.
textos.Várias reviews positivas destacam que a: Several positive reviews highlight that the slowness and the repetition of routines are not flaws but deliberate choices that create an immersive, hypnotic experience, forcing the viewer to feel the weight of existence.
textos.A fotografia em preto e branco de textur: The richly textured black-and-white cinematography and the long sequence shots are often praised as elements that give the film an austere, almost pictorial beauty.
textos.Nihilismo e peso da existência: Nihilism and the weight of existence
textos.Muitas reviews associam o filme a uma pr: Many reviews associate the film with a deep reflection on nihilism, meaninglessness and the harshness of life, describing it as a work that conveys hopelessness and existential emptiness.
textos.A trilha sonora hipnótica e o som consta: The hypnotic score and the constant sound of the wind are cited as essential components that amplify the oppressive atmosphere and the monotony of the experience.
textos.Temas filosóficos e referências a Nietzs: Philosophical themes and references to Nietzsche
textos.Algumas reviews mencionam a conexão com: Some reviews mention the connection with Nietzsche's philosophy and the story of the philosopher's mental collapse, interpreting the film as an exploration of concepts such as eternal return and decay.
textos.O filme é descrito como uma experiência: The film is described as an intense, oppressive sensory experience that envelops the viewer in a hostile, melancholic environment, often compared to an art installation or a meditative state.

textos.Dirigido por Béla Tarr e lançado em 2011: Directed by Béla Tarr and released in 2011, the drama The Turin Horse starts from the historical episode involving the philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche and an animal in Turin in the late nineteenth century. From that event, the feature follows the path of a farmer, his daughter and their sick horse in a miserable existence.
textos.A experiência do filme se constrói por m: The film's experience is built through a markedly slow pace and the systematic repetition of daily routines, structured in long takes and black-and-white cinematography. The composition rests on a constant sound atmosphere, leading to an austere setting geared toward existential themes.
textos.Em termos de recepção, os grupos concord: In terms of reception, the groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~85%), a significant share argue that the slow pace and the intentional repetition make up an immersive approach to routine. Likewise, a good portion praise the black-and-white cinematography and the long takes for their aesthetic quality, while several emphasize the treatment of nihilism and the weight of existence as a forceful reflection.
textos.Numa fração mínima das notas (~10%), seg: In a minimal fraction of the ratings (~10%), according to this assessment, nearly all find the slow, repetitive pace tiring, although most admire the cinematography and visual aesthetic, with about half commenting on the existential themes and nihilism. Finally, from the perspective found in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~5%), nearly all reject the excessively slow, tedious pace, while most point to the lack of plot and character development, and half of them criticize the perception of artistic pretension and elitism.
